label: Arc 4 is one thing only
from: House nearly finished · guest rooms appear · James and Ragnar tension rises
to: GHOST HAVEN IS BUILT AND CHRISTENED — that is the whole arc
note: Ruled directly by Viraena: Arc 4's entire arc is the house going up and being christened, and that is it. No adoptions, no second spine. The beats the master index carried — the two guest rooms appearing, the decorating chaos, the first Halloween and Thanksgiving — are the texture of the christening rather than threads beside it. The James and Ragnar tension line was not confirmed and is held pending the full summaries.
